description: Zero-knowledge single-file baseline seal + 1-Click Stamped Copy + 4-Plate Provenance Certificate: Computes the SHA-256 hash of a local file ENTIRELY ON THE LOCAL MACHINE (0 bytes uploaded), supports Hardware Passkey attribution (`biometric: true`) or Standard SHA-256 digest sealing, anchors the 64-char hash to the Bitcoin Timechain & VDF via Rel-Time, saves the 64-ray Sun-Stamp SVG, JSON Doomsday Proof, 4-Plate Sovereign Cryptographic Provenance Certificate (`reltime-certificate-<name>.html`), and automatically creates a Stamped Copy (`reltime-stamped-<name>.pdf` or `.png`) for PDFs and Images.

anchor_mode.description: Use 'standard' (default) to anchor the file/passkey SHA-256 hash into the Bitcoin Merkle tree for standalone file verification, or 'temporal' to anchor the VDF Thermodynamic Proof (T_index) for sub-second sequential ordering.

api_key.description: Optional override for RELTIME_API_KEY (Agent Launch Pack, Agentic Sequencer, or Sovereign Command bearer key).

biometric.description: If true, performs a Passkey-Attested Anchor using your linked hardware Passkey (TouchID / FaceID / YubiKey) so the anchored hash (`SHA256(File_Hash + Passkey_PubKey)`) and Sun-Stamp mathematically prove your authorship. If no Passkey is linked yet, automatically opens the browser TouchID/FaceID prompt.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the local file to hash and anchor.

open_certificate_in_browser.description: If true, opens the generated 4-Plate Sovereign Cryptographic Provenance Certificate HTML in the system browser.

save_certificate_html.description: If true (default), saves the 4-Plate Sovereign Cryptographic Provenance Certificate (`reltime-certificate-<filename>.html`) in the same folder as the file.

save_stamped_copy.description: If true (default), automatically generates `reltime-stamped-<name>.pdf` or `.png` with the crisp 64-ray Sun-Stamp in the bottom-right corner when the file is a PDF or Image.

save_sun_stamp_svg.description: If true (default), saves `reltime-stamp-<filename>.svg` in the same folder as the file.

name: reltime_anchor_file
